title: Chapter 1193 - 13: Slash Slash Slash! (Seeking Subscription)
content:
Chapter 1193 - 13: Slash Slash Slash! (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1193: Chapter 13: Slash Slash Slash! (Seeking Subscription)

"I’m definitely interested."

Lin Yuan said.

Exploring a newly born treasure land, especially a top-tier one, is a rare opportunity for a Heavenly Venerate.

Currently, the six Ancient Countries together only possess a few hundred top-tier treasure lands.

And these few hundred top-tier treasure lands are the result of long years of accumulation.

An ordinary Heavenly Venerate might never experience the birth of a top-tier treasure land from birth to reaching the Thirteenth Realm.

"Hahaha."

The Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s emperor smiled.

As an emperor, one must balance various forces.

But when encountering genuine benefits, family comes first.

That’s why he met with Lin Yuan first, overpowering the Heavenly Venerates waiting outside.

"However, although I have the right to decide who can represent the Ancient Country in the competition, you will still need to demonstrate some strength later."

The Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s emperor looked at Lin Yuan, "Otherwise, other Heavenly Venerates might be dissatisfied."

"Naturally."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Indeed, competing for a newly born treasure land, any participating Heavenly Venerate can gain rewards.

But undoubtedly, the ones who capture the treasure land gain the most.

If forcing in a vacancy results in failing to capture the treasure land and losing to other Ancient Countries,

even the emperor might not be able to suppress that outcome.

Factional struggles must be placed behind the Ancient Country’s interests; this is the rule of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

"Hmm?"

The Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s emperor looked at Lin Yuan, a bit surprised.

He could sense Lin Yuan’s confidence.

"Generally speaking, the strength of a Heavenly Venerate participating in the competition for a treasure land should at least meet the Peak Venerable threshold. Are you confident?" The Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s emperor’s tone was slightly solemn.

Lin Yuan had excavated his ancestral bloodline to an unprecedented Heavenly Venerate level, and according to the potential of the ancestral bloodline, reaching the limit would make him stronger than the Peak Venerable.

But that is contingent upon reaching the limit.

For instance, a core royal family member at the rank of Great Lord, if not reaching their limit, cannot be considered invincible among Great Lords.

"I’ll do my best."

Lin Yuan said.

The Peak Venerates of the six Ancient Countries are equivalent to the Great Saints of the Chaos Void.

And Lin Yuan, even before breaking through the Space-Time Rule to the Ninth Realm, could slightly contend with Great Saints.

Later, as his comprehension of space-time reached the Ninth Realm, continuing to study the Thirteenth Realm Sky Void Tripod, and his insights into Fierce Sun and Xuanyin in this source world,

Lin Yuan’s true strength was a significant leap from when he previously confronted Great Saint Hunxiao.

"Just do your best."

The Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s emperor nodded: "Later, I will let those Heavenly Venerates come in and announce externally that you are included in the competition for a treasure land."

"If the other Heavenly Venerates have significant objections, select a Peak Venerable to duel with you."

"You only need to hold out for a while to prove that you have the strength of a Peak Venerable, and there should be no problems."

The Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s emperor looked at Lin Yuan.

"Understood."

Lin Yuan understood.

In the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, the royal family can certainly receive resource preference, but the premise is they cannot be too weak; otherwise, it’s a waste of resources.

"Then I’ll let them in."

The Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s emperor glanced outside the palace.

Before long.

One powerful presence after another entered, all the Heavenly Venerates of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, many of whom had been in retreat for many years but came out due to the newly born top-tier treasure land.

"Emperor."

All the Heavenly Venerates slightly bowed, showing respect, their gazes intentionally or unintentionally falling on Lin Yuan.

"Galaxy?"

"Is he the royal family member who excavated his bloodline to the Heavenly Venerate level?"

"The emperor met him first, so it’s likely one of the twelve spots is predetermined for him."

The numerous Heavenly Venerates stared at Lin Yuan, their thoughts fluctuating, considering there are only twelve spots available for the competition, Lin Yuan taking one means one less for them.

"Let me introduce." The Fierce Sun emperor smiled and said: "This is Galaxy, the first core royal family member at the Heavenly Venerate level of my Fierce Sun Ancient Country."

After introducing Lin Yuan, the Fierce Sun Ancient Country began introducing the various Heavenly Venerates.

In fact, there’s no real need for an introduction. With the reputation of a Heavenly Venerate, Lin Yuan just needs to slightly sense their aura to know which Heavenly Venerate they are.

Currently, thirty-some Heavenly Venerates stood in the palace, among them, twenty had the strength of Peak Venerables, and the remaining ten or so were close to the strength of Peak Venerables.

Of course, this doesn’t mean the number of Peak Venerables is greater than ordinary Heavenly Venerates in the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, but that the Heavenly Venerates present here are just a portion, though the most elite part.

Lin Yuan looked at each Heavenly Venerate, nodding one by one.

Among the Heavenly Venerates, three were recognized as the strongest, namely Red Flame Venerable, Venerable Hengyang, and Venerable Guanglie.

These three are all Peak Venerables, and the paths of Chaos Power they have evolved are incredibly powerful, shaking the six Ancient Countries.

"Alright, I won’t waste words." The Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s emperor looked at the many Heavenly Venerates: "This time, with the appearance of a top-tier treasure land, my Fierce Sun Ancient Country will have twelve spots for participation in the competition. I won’t interfere with the other eleven spots, but Galaxy must take one."

"Does anyone have any objections?"

The Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s emperor said directly.

With those words.

The palace fell silent.

The many Heavenly Venerates glanced at each other, unable to help but look towards Red Flame Venerable, Venerable Hengyang, and Venerable Guanglie.

The emperor’s request isn’t excessive, only asking for one of the twelve spots, and they initially thought there would be more royal family members arranged.

Among the royal family, there are also strong figures at the Heavenly Venerate level, but here, the Heavenly Venerates refer to those who have realized the paths of Chaos Power evolution.

"Not appropriate." At this time, Red Flame Venerable suddenly spoke.

"With the potential of Galaxy Venerate, he is indeed worth cultivating." Red Flame Venerable glanced at Lin Yuan, "But competing for a top-tier treasure land relies on strength, and every Heavenly Venerate participating must not be a burden."
